ImageDescription.value:
I was always struck by the especially unusual natural setting rather than studio, especially as this has the feel of an 1860s image. Then I was contacted by someone suggesting that this may be a previously unknown portrait of the famous Greyfriars Bobby. I'm still not 100% sure, but I do think it's a strong possibility - see comments below.

Unknown date - I suspect it's another late 1860s/early 1870s image. In fact according to www.edinphoto.org.uk/p/photographers_Pa.htm he was only at 4 North College St from 1858 - 1867, putting it firmly in the 1860s. It's quite an unusual style of back, and it appears that North College St is what is now Chambers St, though I'm not sure if the renaming also involved renumbering.

---

One of 140 images from a fascinating album. For more information see the full set

Just how many of these images can we identify, and what can we find out about the people they portray?
